Name: Stardual Valley - Dual Screen for SDV
Author: eloteenthusiast
Description:
A comprehensive dual screen experience for Stardew Valley. Works with Cinderbox (and most likely other Android-based launchers)

[b]Second Screen Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]Main: time, weather, luck, gold, energy, health and your whole backpack, with touch controls to select, move, sort and eat items[/*]
[*]Map: the world map with villagers on it (works with NPC Map Locations)[/*]
[*]Farm: crops to water or harvest, machines, animals and fruit trees[/*]
[*]Journal, Bundles, Calendar: quests, what each bundle still needs, birthdays and festivals[/*]
[*]People: hearts, gifts given this week, who you have talked to today[/*]
[*]Crafting: what you can make right now[/*]
[*]Wiki: search any item, villager, shop, fish or place. Built from the game's own data, so it works offline and includes modded items[/*]
[*]Cheats (experimental and optional, off by default): freeze time, walking speed, warps, open any door, hearts, add items[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements:[/b]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later

[b]Notes[/b]
- Built and tested on an AYN Thor. Other setups have not been tried yet, so reports are welcome!
- AI was used to create this mod - if this is a concern, you may want to look for an alternative
- Some info may be outdated or incorrect. If you discover any errors or bugs, please share them here!

[b]Credits[/b]
Profmags' Stardew Dual Screen mod was used for the game-reading code with permission
